subject: QBR roadmap + compact demo — proposal for alternating live/recorded cadence

From: Jamie Liao <jamie.liao@healthbridge.com>

Subject: QBR planning — demo cadence idea

Hi Marissa / team,

Thanks again for the plan outline. Exec calendars are tight on our side for the week of Sep 11 — they prefer highly timeboxed live sessions + a recorded deep-dive they can watch asynchronously.

Two quick asks:
- Can Redwood propose a lightweight format that alternates a 30-minute live exec-friendly overview with a 45–60 minute pre-recorded deep-dive we host?
- Wed like the recorded asset to include an ops checklist and short how-to for our infra/ops folks.

If you can send a proposed cadence + a few concrete slot options, Id share with Procurement and Ops and loop them into scheduling.

Best,
Jamie
Head of Partnerships, HealthBridge

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Fri, 24 Aug 2028 12:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: QBR planning — demo cadence idea

Hi Jamie — really appreciate the clarity on exec constraints. High level proposal below and attached a short agenda + slot matrix so Ops/Procurement can see tangible options.

Proposal (alternating cadence):
- Live (30 min): Executive summary + 2 priority wins; Q&A (we keep it to exec-level discussion).
- Recorded (45 min): Technical walkthrough, infra notes, and a 10-min ops checklist video. Available 48 hours before the live date so your teams can pre-read.
- Follow-up office hours (30 min): Optional; technical drop-in with our infra lead.

Suggested weeks (US time windows):
- Option A: Sep 12 AM PT (live) / Sep 14 recorded release
- Option B: Sep 19 PM ET (live) / Sep 21 recorded release

Attachments: HB-QBR-agenda-proposal.pdf (agenda + description), calendar_slots.xlsx (slot matrix).

Next steps: if you confirm Option A or B (or propose alternatives) well send calendar holds and the recorded asset draft link.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Director | Redwood Inference
